experience.title: Computer Vision Research Engineer

Collaborated with team members using version control systems such as Git to organize modifications and assign tasks.

This experience covers a wide range of technologies from generative AI and LLMs to full-stack web development.

projects.name: Diagnosis Of Heart Patients Using Deep Neural Network
projects.description: Created web applications using CNN, Python, FastAPI, and React to predict whether a person has heart disease. Processed user-inputted information in the back-end to return a subtotal prediction based on ECG Image input. Utilized a comprehensive ECG image dataset with Pandas and OpenCV to convert images to grayscale, resize, and save as NumPy arrays. Designed a neural network with sigmoid activation and integrated it into a FastAPI backend, gaining skills in deep learning and full-stack development. (Technologies: Python, React, CNN, Pandas, Keras, Tensorflow, Numpy, Matplotlib, OpenCV, Fast API, Firebase)
